column2: For a proper Cruise team, you should go for 1 attacker + 1 (2) bomber (s) +1 (2) healer (s) (Example: Heidi + Lantern + Diana + Joy).  -> a FOUR-hunter team, with an optional fifth.
Current best cruise deck is 1 attacker + Dumble + Crocus + Leon.  -> FOUR.
The most popular one is Windblade/Genovia/Vincent, paired with either Sienna / Audrey for bombers, + Westfield/Celine/Lottery Mouse.  -> FIVE (3+2).
Some people replace Celine / Westfield with Captain for a reliable frontline back up  -> swapping one for one, still five.
...if it's on the frontline and the fifth skill needs to be properly combined...  -> "fifth SKILL", not fifth unit.
